text.p: Tropical Depression 09W becomes Tropical Storm Peter, may threaten the northeastern Philippines. Tropical Storm Peter, with 40 mph winds, is near 13.7n/128.2e, moving west at 5 mph. It is exected to intensify slowly and turn more to the northwest with time, taking the storm center to the east of Luzon, Philippines. Luzon may see gusty winds and heavy rain from this system, with local flooding and mudslides possible.
There are no further statements at this time.
